definitions.MANUAL: No supported known generic route and no specific alternative implementation evidence.
definitions.PARTIAL: A supported direct mechanical or reviewed plug-in component plus manual or unresolved parts.
definitions.REAL_FULL: Verified within the audit's bounded static validators; not a proof that the typed record faithfully includes every printed rule.
definitions.UNKNOWN: Static analysis cannot establish applicability or completeness; never counted as full.
definitions.component_counts: Effect counts plus explicit empty-branch or unproved route/field checks; structural delivery nodes are not state-changing effects.
definitions.direct_action_gm_lines: Subset on proven ordinary action/menu routes before character-specific modifications. One template counted once per mechanic.
definitions.gm_reminder_lines: Distinct texts retained by the real _gm_lines for every mechanic's included branches, deduplicated within each mechanic. This is a catalogue backlog of reminder templates, not a transcript count.
definitions.plugin_claims: Executable reference/registration/dispatch evidence; claims do not prove complete automation.
definitions.variant_gm_line_instances: Same filter before per-mechanic deduplication; shared reminders recur on menu options.
